_what: How an AI or an analysis proposes changes to a record while the person watches (suggestion-stream.mjs): a stream of typed lines, one JSON object per line. `lines` name each type and the fields it must carry; `errors` are the codes an ending in failure may carry, with their words. A finished suggestion is kept by (input, mode) with the algorithm's `algorithm_version`: a later version never reads an earlier one's answer. `modes` are the ways a suggestion can be asked for, as rows the producer reads (for cutting a recording: only long silences, or only filler words); adding a mode is one row.

errors.FAILED: The suggestion could not be made.
errors.UNREADABLE: A line of the suggestion could not be read.
errors.NO_TRANSCRIPT: This recording has no timed words yet, so there is nothing to cut by.
